name: manual_7065d5
claim: JSON-RPC multiplexing over a single stdio backend: mangle request IDs to '{client_id}:{original_id}' before forwarding; on responses, split by ':' to demux back to the originating client. Cache initialize capabilities and tools/list results so subsequent clients are served from cache without hitting the backend.

decisions.notes: Used in exa-mcp-daemon.py to multiplex multiple Claude sessions through one npx exa-mcp-server process. ID splitting handles both int and string original IDs. 2026-07-04.
